links.outcome: Flesch Reading Ease of chatbot answers to dental veneer patient questions
links.effect: Mean FRES was 38.92 ± 9.26 for Gemini-3.5 Flash (highest) and 25.33 ± 11.67 for DeepSeek-V4 (lowest). Both are in the difficult-to-read range, so no chatbot produced plain-language answers.
links.quote: For readability, Gemini-3.5 Flash (38.92 ± 9.26 ) obtained the highest FRES score, while DeepSeek-V4 (25.33 ± 11.67) showed the lowest readability.

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates the accuracy, readability, and reliability of four LLMs answering patient FAQs about dental veneers using standard assessment rubrics, without testing a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
